purpose: Short primary-source anchors for the scope distinctions; not an exhaustive literature review.

anchors.source: Lee and Levitov, Universality in Phyllotaxis: a Mechanical Theory, 1998 / arXiv 2021
anchors.quote: the structure does not track the global energy minimum
anchors.supports: Fibonacci growth evolution must not be cited as a theorem of unrestricted global optimality.

anchors.source: Sun et al., Geometric frustration of hard-disk packings on cones, PRE 108, 054608 (2023)
anchors.quote: Perfect crystals lack seams and can form only when the sector angle is a “magic” angle
anchors.supports: Commensurate triangular cone crystals are prior art; the following formula in the source is phi = 60 degrees P.

anchors.source: Sun et al., Colloidal Crystallization on Cones, PRL 134, 018201 (2025)
anchors.quote: crystals on a cone tend to form tilt grain boundaries with misorientation angles set by the conical geometry
anchors.supports: Cone-crystal experimental phenomenology extends beyond defect-free Fibonacci spirals.

anchors.source: Akiyama, Spiral Delone sets and three distance theorem, arXiv:1904.10815 (2019)
anchors.quote: a constant angle progression on the Fermat spiral forms a Delone set if and only if its angle is badly approximable
anchors.supports: Uniform-discreteness/uniformity theorem, not unconstrained disk-packing optimality.

anchors.source: J. Albert, Ideas for Projects: Version 3, Summer 2008
anchors.quote: Researchers conjecture that least-energy configurations of discs (I think) on a cone lie in Fibonacci spirals
anchors.supports: An informal course-project conjecture, not a precisely specified densest-packing theorem.
anchors.read_level: primary PDF; quote normalizes extraction ligatures

anchors.source: Chang and Wang, A Simple Proof of Thue's Theorem on Circle Packing, arXiv:1009.4322 (2010)
anchors.quote: The hexagonal lattice is the densest of all possible circle packings.
anchors.supports: Imported planar density upper bound used after lifting the quotient cone.

access_limits: Several publisher pages returned 403 or 401; accessible author manuscripts, Crossref-deposited abstracts, and PubMed supplied the cited evidence. Search summaries were not treated as proof.
